title: Unattended Micro Market Program: Fixture, Range and Kiosk Specification by Market Format
content:
Every market format in the Unattended Micro Market Program is built to a printed specification: the number of self-checkout kiosks, the number of refrigerated units, whether a frozen unit forms part of the format, how many distinct products the planogram carries, how many of those are fresh or chilled, whether a loss prevention camera is installed with the market, whether employees may pay by the mobile wallet at the kiosk, and the depth of shelf nutrition labelling. The specification below is the one printed against each format, and the format written on the agreement governs.

## Specification by format

| Market format | Self-checkout kiosks | Refrigerated units | Frozen unit | Distinct products | Fresh and chilled products | Loss prevention camera | Mobile wallet at kiosk | Nutrition labelling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | 0 | 1 | not included | 60 | 0 | not included | not enabled | basic |
| Compact Micro Market | 1 | 2 | not included | 140 | 15 | not included | enabled | basic |
| Standard Micro Market | 1 | 3 | included | 280 | 45 | included | enabled | standard |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | 2 | 5 | included | 420 | 120 | included | enabled | enhanced |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | 3 | 8 | included | 650 | 180 | included | enabled | enhanced |
| Smart Store Micro Market | 2 | 4 | included | 380 | 95 | included | enabled | enhanced |

## Points of judgement

A format's fresh and chilled range is a subset of its distinct product count, so the Fresh Food Micro Market's 120 fresh and chilled lines sit inside its 420 distinct products. A frozen unit is carried by the Standard Micro Market, the Fresh Food Micro Market, the Expanded Campus Micro Market and the Smart Store Micro Market, and by neither of the two smallest formats. The Cooler & Snack Wall is the only format specified with no self-checkout kiosk and no fresh or chilled line at all.

Where a site is served by the Smart Store Micro Market, the specification read is that format's own column: 2 kiosks, 4 refrigerated units, a frozen unit, 380 distinct products and 95 fresh and chilled lines, whatever the site's headcount or sales might suggest about a neighbouring format.
